equivalent_mutants.reason: Reviewed current ordinary populate path: changing the physical LB_ADDSTRING result predicate changes only the local unsigned count and its returned value. The owned 0x49c090 entry declares void and the only internal ordinary caller, dialog INIT, discards populate return; count never affects memory, calls, item traversal or selection. The physical callback implementation uses a separate stack-backed count and is not covered by this review.

Independent fresh translator and case-author original-byte audits agree: shifting the second player+0x25c0 null guard by four differs only for input 0xffffda40 or 0xffffda3c; preceding first-block reads are 0x58..0x7c or 0x54..0x78, outside the retained valid live-object domain. No new coverage exemption. Original evidence and both audits: work/readability/player_cache_application/new-translator-audit.txt and new-case-audit.txt.
